name: Driven Worker

choices.label: Driven Worker: Craft, Perform or Profession
Driven Worker: the specialty (alchemy, sing, sailor, ...)

text: **Driven Worker**: Many halfling families have developed techniques to accomplish work faster and more efficiently, whether to contribute to the community or to please overbearing masters. These halflings gain a +4 racial bonus on checks with one Craft, Perform, or Profession skill. This racial trait replaces sure-footed.
